iforest.title: Stubble Burning Status Report 2025
iforest.summary: iFOREST reports approximately 37% less Punjab Kharif burnt area in 2025 than its 2022 peak, using Sentinel-2 mapping. This is an independent area-based estimate with a different baseline and unit from official fire counts or GK2A pixel-days.
iforest.caveat: The report says 2025 analysis uses data through 27 November and may rise. Its slide 25 headline says 35%, while its final summary and press release say 37%. Attribute the approximate 37% to the published summary; do not treat it as a recalibration of the official 2021 comparison.

snpp_cessation.title: Update #4 — S-NPP Data Delivery Cessation & Decommissioning Status
snpp_cessation.summary: NOAA confirms that S-NPP science-data distribution ceased at 15:40 UTC on 2 November 2026. This is supported by the NOAA status notice, separately from whether a seven-day FIRMS CSV is empty.
